prompt: In a fairy tale forest, a woodsman with a large axe is standing in front of a small, crooked cottage that has two windows. A witch with a pointy hat is peeking from behind the cottage door, looking at the woodsman. The woodsman, who appears younger and stronger, is holding the axe over his shoulder. The witch appears older and more frail than the woodsman. A black cat is sitting on the cottage's thatched roof, arching its back at the woodsman. The woodsman is taller than the cottage door. The cottage is smaller than a large, gnarled tree growing next to it. On a branch of the tree, a small group of birds is perched above the cat; the number of birds is one more than the number of windows on the cottage. The witch is holding one bubbling potion in a vial. On the windowsill of the cottage, there are several mushrooms; their number is three times the number of potions the witch is holding. The cat is between the birds and the witch. The cat is hissing at the woodsman.
